items.title: Chick Corea — Smithsonian Jazz Oral History
items.q: That’s when we found Mingo Lewis, playing conga. That was the first Return To Forever.

ctx.x: Well, I met him playing with Miles, but I really came into a friendship with Lenny through Stanley. Stanley recommended Lenny for the new band, the Hymn of the Seventh Galaxy band. So we went out... Stanley and I engaged Lenny to be a trio at Todd Barkan’s San Francisco’s place, and we played a week there to audition guitar players. That was our purpose.

That’s when we found Billy Connors on the guitar—he was living out there. That’s when we found Mingo Lewis, playing conga. That was the first Return To Forever. Then the trio kind of came together real quick.
The feel you got was a certain definitive sound of that period. Whatever it was that you got together seems to be a lasting thing, apart from everything else...
